description: This file contains unit tests for the JsonSchemaVersion class, verifying its immutability and behavior of the forInt method with known and unknown values.

classes.name: JsonSchemaVersionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for JsonSchemaVersion, testing immutability and forInt method behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonSchemaVersion class instances are immutable and that Predicate is also immutable.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionForUnknownVersionIntReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Tests that for an unknown integer, JsonSchemaVersion.forInt returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionForKnownVersionIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that for a known integer, JsonSchemaVersion.forInt returns the correct version.
